supported_fields.mechanics_notes: Strike Super associated with Goku (Mini) using the Power Pole. The move strikes and kicks the opponent away before chasing them; holding the fly input improves the forward dash and permits an immediate follow-up. Current repository evidence preserves the documented follow-up behavior without inferring unsupported damage or frame data.
